svg.aria-label: Maven Deploy, Pipesmith Registry 0.2.1. mvn deploy sends one PUT per file; the server stores each file as sent and builds no metadata. 1: mvn deploy to Server: PUT .../invoice-core/1.2.0/invoice-core-1.2.0.jar. 2: Server to Policies: add or edit permission; ALLOW, ALLOW_ONCE or DENY. 3: Policies: releases or snapshots only; strict Maven layout. 4: Server to local-write: bytes and properties in content/<minute>/. 5: Server to index.sqlite: row in files_<store>. 6: Server to mvn deploy: 201. 7: mvn deploy: the same for the pom, each checksum and maven-metadata.xml. 8: Server: stores each file as sent; a wrong checksum only logs a warning. 9: Server to mvn deploy: refused: 400 policy or layout, 413 size, 507 disk, 503 index busy.
svg.title: Pipesmith Registry maven deploy
